NAME:
   rancher create cloud-credential - Create a cloud credential for a node driver or for etcd snapshots in S3

USAGE:
   rancher create cloud-credential [flags] <driver> <display-name>

FLAGS:
   --description description                          the credential's description
   --from-file field=path [ --from-file field=path ]  a secret or multi-line field of the driver and the file that has its value, as field=path; a path of - reads stdin once; repeat the flag for more fields
   --help, -h                                         show help
   --set field=value [ --set field=value ]            a public field of the driver, as field=value; repeat the flag for more fields
   --wait                                             wait until you can read the new credential (default true; --wait=false returns as soon as Rancher accepts the request)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
